note: Tatoeba 没覆盖到的考研词，由本项目自己写一句真实用法的例句兜底（附中文译文）。import-tatoeba-ky-examples.mjs 会优先用这里的句子，没有的才退回占位句。

retrospection.text: In retrospection, the decision to sell the house seemed hasty.
retrospection.translation: 回想起来，卖掉房子的决定显得仓促。

despatch.text: The embassy will despatch a courier with the documents tomorrow morning.
despatch.translation: 大使馆明天早上将派信使送交这些文件。

goodby.text: She waved goodby from the train window as it pulled away.
goodby.translation: 火车开动时，她从车窗里挥手告别。

maltreat.text: The new law makes it a crime to maltreat farm animals.
maltreat.translation: 新法律规定虐待农场动物属于犯罪。

sufficiency.text: The report questioned the sufficiency of the evidence presented at trial.
sufficiency.translation: 报告质疑庭审中提交的证据是否充分。

instrumentalist.text: Every instrumentalist in the orchestra tuned up before the concert began.
instrumentalist.translation: 音乐会开始前，乐团里的每位演奏者都调好了音。

malign.text: It is unfair to malign a colleague who is not here to defend himself.
malign.translation: 诋毁一位不在场、无法为自己辩护的同事是不公平的。

perplex.text: The sudden change in policy continues to perplex economists.
perplex.translation: 政策的突然变化仍然让经济学家们困惑不解。

resultant.text: The merger and the resultant layoffs shook the entire town.
resultant.translation: 这次合并及其导致的裁员震动了整个小镇。

futility.text: After hours of argument, he finally recognized the futility of the debate.
futility.translation: 争论了几个小时后，他终于意识到这场辩论毫无意义。

dramatize.text: Newspapers tend to dramatize minor incidents to attract readers.
dramatize.translation: 报纸往往把小事件渲染得很戏剧化以吸引读者。

appall.text: The conditions in the refugee camp would appall any visitor.
appall.translation: 难民营里的条件会让任何来访者感到震惊。

appal.text: Reports of the famine continue to appal the international community.
appal.translation: 有关饥荒的报道持续令国际社会震惊。

endow.text: The foundation decided to endow a scholarship for rural students.
endow.translation: 基金会决定为农村学生捐设一项奖学金。

gramme.text: The recipe calls for exactly one gramme of saffron.
gramme.translation: 这道食谱恰好需要一克藏红花。

administrate.text: The board hired a new manager to administrate the fund.
administrate.translation: 董事会聘请了一位新经理来管理这只基金。

utilise.text: Farmers in the region utilise every drop of rainwater during the dry season.
utilise.translation: 旱季里，该地区的农民把每一滴雨水都利用起来。

esthetic.text: The new bridge was praised for its esthetic appeal as much as its strength.
esthetic.translation: 这座新桥因其美感和坚固程度同样受到称赞。

proximate.text: The proximate cause of the fire was a faulty heater, not the old wiring.
proximate.translation: 火灾的直接原因是一台有故障的取暖器，而不是老化的电线。

gasolene.text: The old truck burns gasolene far faster than a modern car.
gasolene.translation: 这辆旧卡车耗汽油的速度远超现代汽车。

instal.text: The landlord promised to instal a new lock before the tenants moved in.
instal.translation: 房东承诺在租户搬进来之前安装一把新锁。

mobilise.text: The charity managed to mobilise thousands of volunteers within a week.
mobilise.translation: 这家慈善机构在一周内动员了数千名志愿者。

normalisation.text: The two countries signed a treaty marking the normalisation of relations.
normalisation.translation: 两国签署了一项条约，标志着关系正常化。

reflexion.text: After some reflexion, he decided to accept the job offer.
reflexion.translation: 经过一番思考，他决定接受这份工作。

sympathise.text: I sympathise with anyone who has to commute two hours each day.
sympathise.translation: 我很同情每天要通勤两小时的人。

illiquidity.text: The bank's illiquidity forced it to borrow at a very high rate.
illiquidity.translation: 这家银行流动性不足，被迫以极高的利率借款。

gloominess.text: A sense of gloominess hung over the office after the layoffs were announced.
gloominess.translation: 裁员消息公布后，办公室里笼罩着一种阴郁的气氛。

innovativeness.text: The company's innovativeness helped it survive when competitors failed.
innovativeness.translation: 这家公司的创新能力帮助它在竞争对手倒闭时存活了下来。

disputable.text: Whether the policy actually reduced crime is highly disputable.
disputable.translation: 这项政策是否真的减少了犯罪，是很有争议的。

bellyful.text: After three hours of complaints, she had had a bellyful of the meeting.
bellyful.translation: 听了三个小时的抱怨，她对这场会议已经受够了。

innovatively.text: The team innovatively reused old shipping containers as classrooms.
innovatively.translation: 团队别出心裁地把旧集装箱改成了教室。

decider.text: With the score tied, the final match became the decider.
decider.translation: 比分打平，最后一场比赛成了决胜局。

eightfold.text: Sales of electric bikes increased eightfold in just five years.
eightfold.translation: 电动自行车的销量在短短五年内增长了八倍。

crabbed.text: The letter was written in a crabbed hand that was almost impossible to read.
crabbed.translation: 这封信的字迹潦草难认，几乎无法辨读。

lameness.text: The vet examined the horse's leg to find the cause of its lameness.
lameness.translation: 兽医检查了马腿，想找出它跛行的原因。

illiquid.text: Real estate is an illiquid asset; you cannot sell a house overnight.
illiquid.translation: 房地产是流动性差的资产，你无法一夜之间卖掉房子。

megalith.text: Each megalith at the site weighs more than twenty tons.
megalith.translation: 遗址上的每块巨石都重达二十多吨。

demoralization.text: Months without pay led to the demoralization of the entire staff.
demoralization.translation: 几个月拿不到工资，导致全体员工士气低落。

capuchin.text: A capuchin monkey snatched the tourist's sandwich and ran up a tree.
capuchin.translation: 一只卷尾猴抢走了游客的三明治，窜上了树。

glowingly.text: Her former manager spoke glowingly of her work ethic.
glowingly.translation: 她的前经理对她的职业操守赞不绝口。

codependency.text: The counselor explained how codependency can keep both partners from growing.
codependency.translation: 咨询师解释了共依赖关系如何阻碍双方的成长。

unrepresentative.text: A survey of only city residents would be unrepresentative of the whole country.
unrepresentative.translation: 只调查城市居民的结果无法代表整个国家。

teamster.text: The teamster drove his truck through the night to deliver the goods on time.
teamster.translation: 卡车司机连夜赶路，按时把货送到。

unionism.text: Unionism grew rapidly among factory workers in the early twentieth century.
unionism.translation: 二十世纪初，工会运动在工厂工人中迅速发展。

econometric.text: The paper uses an econometric model to estimate the effect of tax cuts.
econometric.translation: 这篇论文用计量经济模型来估计减税的效果。

longline.text: Longline fishing boats can set hooks stretching for many kilometres.
longline.translation: 延绳钓渔船能布下绵延数公里的钓钩。

inescapably.text: Rising costs are inescapably linked to the shortage of skilled workers.
inescapably.translation: 成本上升与技术工人短缺之间的联系是无法回避的。

fourfold.text: The number of applicants rose fourfold after the program was advertised online.
fourfold.translation: 项目在网上宣传后，申请人数增长了四倍。

filer.text: Every tax filer must submit the form before the April deadline.
filer.translation: 每位报税人都必须在四月的截止日期前提交表格。

hominid.text: The fossil belongs to a hominid that lived about three million years ago.
hominid.translation: 这块化石属于大约三百万年前生活的一种人科动物。

noncommercial.text: The photos may be used for noncommercial purposes without permission.
noncommercial.translation: 这些照片可用于非商业目的，无需授权。

reasonableness.text: The court will judge the reasonableness of the fee charged by the lawyer.
reasonableness.translation: 法院将判断律师收费是否合理。

transferable.text: The skills you learn in debate are transferable to almost any career.
transferable.translation: 你在辩论中学到的技能可以迁移到几乎任何职业。

perpetuity.text: The land was donated to the city in perpetuity as a public park.
perpetuity.translation: 这块地被永久捐赠给市政府作为公园。

misdeed.text: He finally confessed to the misdeed he had hidden for years.
misdeed.translation: 他终于承认了自己隐瞒多年的不端行为。

physiologist.text: The physiologist measured how the athletes' hearts responded to altitude.
physiologist.translation: 生理学家测量了运动员的心脏对海拔的反应。

constitutionality.text: The Supreme Court will rule on the constitutionality of the new law.
constitutionality.translation: 最高法院将就新法律是否合宪作出裁决。

rationalization.text: His excuse sounded like a rationalization rather than a real reason.
rationalization.translation: 他的借口听起来像是自我开脱，而不是真正的理由。

intricacy.text: The intricacy of the clock's mechanism amazed the young engineer.
intricacy.translation: 这座钟机械结构的精巧让年轻工程师惊叹不已。

representational.text: The gallery's new wing is devoted to representational painting.
representational.translation: 画廊的新展区专门展出具象绘画。

commonality.text: Despite their differences, the two cultures share a surprising commonality.
commonality.translation: 尽管存在差异，这两种文化却有着惊人的共同点。

symbolically.text: The mayor symbolically planted the first tree in the new park.
symbolically.translation: 市长象征性地在新公园种下了第一棵树。

agro-technological.text: The agro-technological center trains farmers to use drones and sensors.
agro-technological.translation: 这家农业技术中心培训农民使用无人机和传感器。

authorisation.text: You need written authorisation before entering the laboratory.
authorisation.translation: 进入实验室前你需要书面授权。

belt-tightening.text: The company announced a year of belt-tightening after profits fell.
belt-tightening.translation: 利润下滑后，公司宣布要过一年的紧日子。

biophilia.text: Architects cite biophilia to explain why office plants improve mood.
biophilia.translation: 建筑师用亲生命性来解释办公室植物为何能改善情绪。

café.text: We met at a small café near the station for breakfast.
café.translation: 我们在车站附近的一家小咖啡馆碰面吃早餐。

cross-cutting.text: Climate change is a cross-cutting issue that affects every ministry.
cross-cutting.translation: 气候变化是一个影响所有部门的跨领域问题。

diffusionism.text: Diffusionism holds that most cultural traits spread from a few original centers.
diffusionism.translation: 传播论认为大多数文化特征是从少数源头扩散开来的。

diffusionist.text: A diffusionist would argue that writing was invented once and then borrowed.
diffusionist.translation: 传播论者会认为文字只发明了一次，然后被各地借用。

explicatory.text: The editor added an explicatory note to clarify the obscure passage.
explicatory.translation: 编辑加了一条解释性注释来澄清这段晦涩的文字。

film-making.text: She studied film-making in Paris before directing her first documentary.
film-making.translation: 她在巴黎学习电影制作，之后执导了她的第一部纪录片。

fine-grained.text: The report offers a fine-grained analysis of spending by each department.
fine-grained.translation: 这份报告对各部门的支出作了细致入微的分析。

humourous.text: His humourous speech had the whole audience laughing.
humourous.translation: 他幽默的演讲让全场观众都笑了起来。

jobcentre.text: He visits the jobcentre every Monday to look for new openings.
jobcentre.translation: 他每周一都去就业中心找新的职位空缺。

jobseeker.text: Each jobseeker was paired with an adviser who helped with their CV.
jobseeker.translation: 每位求职者都配了一名顾问帮忙修改简历。

language acquisition.text: Children go through language acquisition without any formal lessons.
language acquisition.translation: 儿童无需正规课程就能完成语言习得。

left-of-centre.text: The party moved to a left-of-centre position on health care.
left-of-centre.translation: 该党在医疗问题上转向了中间偏左的立场。

liberalise.text: The government plans to liberalise the rules on foreign investment.
liberalise.translation: 政府计划放宽外国投资规则。

life-enriching.text: Volunteering abroad turned out to be a life-enriching experience.
life-enriching.translation: 到国外做志愿者成了一段丰富人生的经历。

lineage-specific.text: The gene is lineage-specific, found only in birds and their close relatives.
lineage-specific.translation: 这个基因是谱系特有的，只存在于鸟类及其近亲中。

logicality.text: The judge praised the logicality of the young lawyer's argument.
logicality.translation: 法官称赞了年轻律师论证的逻辑性。

long-fished.text: Cod stocks in the long-fished North Sea have never fully recovered.
long-fished.translation: 长期被捕捞的北海鳕鱼种群从未完全恢复。

mass-market.text: The company shifted from luxury goods to mass-market products.
mass-market.translation: 该公司从奢侈品转向了大众市场产品。

medicalise.text: Critics say we should not medicalise ordinary sadness as a disorder.
medicalise.translation: 批评者说不应把普通的悲伤当作疾病来医疗化。

medicalize.text: There is a tendency to medicalize every difficulty of childhood.
medicalize.translation: 有一种把童年的每个困难都医疗化的倾向。

memento mori.text: The skull on the desk served as a memento mori for the philosopher.
memento mori.translation: 书桌上的头骨是这位哲学家的死亡警示物。

naturalisation.text: After five years in the country she applied for naturalisation.
naturalisation.translation: 在该国居住五年后，她申请了入籍。

noise-making.text: The festival ended with drums and other noise-making instruments.
noise-making.translation: 节日以鼓和其他喧闹的乐器演奏结束。

noncontroversial.text: The bill was noncontroversial and passed without debate.
noncontroversial.translation: 这项法案没有争议，未经辩论就通过了。

noneconomic.text: Family ties are a noneconomic reason for staying in a small town.
noneconomic.translation: 家庭纽带是留在小镇的一个非经济因素。

objectiveness.text: Readers value the objectiveness of the newspaper's science coverage.
objectiveness.translation: 读者看重这家报纸科学报道的客观性。

old-fashionedness.text: The hotel's old-fashionedness is exactly what its guests love.
old-fashionedness.translation: 这家酒店的老派风格正是客人喜欢的地方。

on-trend.text: The shop sells on-trend clothing at prices students can afford.
on-trend.translation: 这家店以学生负担得起的价格出售时下流行的服装。

particularist.text: A particularist approach treats each case on its own terms.
particularist.translation: 个别主义的方法是根据每个案例自身的情况来处理。

peer-review.text: The study passed peer-review before it was published in the journal.
peer-review.translation: 这项研究在期刊发表前通过了同行评审。

precedent-setting.text: The court's precedent-setting ruling will shape future privacy cases.
precedent-setting.translation: 法院这一开创先例的判决将影响未来的隐私案件。

prescription-drug.text: Prescription-drug prices have doubled over the past decade.
prescription-drug.translation: 处方药价格在过去十年翻了一番。

private sector.text: Most new jobs last year were created in the private sector.
private sector.translation: 去年大多数新增岗位来自私营部门。

public sector.text: Public sector workers went on strike over pay.
public sector.translation: 公共部门的员工因薪资问题举行了罢工。

rationalisation.text: The rationalisation of the bus routes cut costs but left some villages unserved.
rationalisation.translation: 公交线路的合理化调整降低了成本，但让一些村庄失去了服务。

résumé.text: Keep your résumé to one page unless you have many years of experience.
résumé.translation: 除非你有多年经验，否则简历保持一页就好。

self-rule.text: The island was granted self-rule after decades of colonial administration.
self-rule.translation: 经过几十年的殖民统治，该岛获得了自治权。

status quo.text: Many voters simply preferred the status quo to an uncertain change.
status quo.translation: 许多选民宁愿维持现状，也不要不确定的改变。

stressed-out.text: Stressed-out students often skip meals during exam week.
stressed-out.translation: 压力过大的学生在考试周常常不吃饭。

superhigh.text: The lab's superhigh-speed camera captures a million frames per second.
superhigh.translation: 实验室的超高速摄像机每秒能拍下一百万帧。

systematicness.text: The systematicness of her notes made revision much easier.
systematicness.translation: 她笔记的系统性让复习轻松了许多。

top-down.text: The reform was imposed top-down, with little input from teachers.
top-down.translation: 这项改革是自上而下推行的，几乎没有听取教师的意见。

turnround.text: The airline cut the turnround time between flights to thirty minutes.
turnround.translation: 这家航空公司把航班间的周转时间缩短到三十分钟。

under-nutrition.text: Under-nutrition still affects millions of children in the region.
under-nutrition.translation: 营养不足仍然影响着该地区数百万儿童。

undistracted.text: She worked undistracted for three hours with her phone switched off.
undistracted.translation: 她关掉手机，心无旁骛地工作了三个小时。

unionise.text: Workers at the warehouse voted to unionise last spring.
unionise.translation: 去年春天，仓库的工人投票决定成立工会。

unreadiness.text: The team's unreadiness for the storm led to costly delays.
unreadiness.translation: 团队对暴风雨准备不足，导致了代价高昂的延误。

well-orchestrated.text: The product launch was a well-orchestrated event that drew huge crowds.
well-orchestrated.translation: 这次产品发布会组织得井井有条，吸引了大批人群。

wholesaling.text: The family business moved from retail into wholesaling of fresh produce.
wholesaling.translation: 这家家族企业从零售转向了新鲜农产品批发。

according to.text: According to the weather report, it will snow tonight.
according to.translation: 据天气预报说，今晚会下雪。

air conditioning.text: The office has no air conditioning, so summers are hard to bear.
air conditioning.translation: 办公室没有空调，夏天很难熬。

ice cream.text: The children lined up for ice cream after the game.
ice cream.translation: 比赛结束后，孩子们排队买冰淇淋。

living room.text: We spent the evening playing cards in the living room.
living room.translation: 我们晚上在客厅里打牌。

ought to.text: You ought to see a doctor about that cough.
ought to.translation: 你那咳嗽应该去看看医生。

owing to.text: The match was cancelled owing to heavy rain.
owing to.translation: 由于大雨，比赛被取消了。

per cent.text: Only forty per cent of the students passed the exam.
per cent.translation: 只有百分之四十的学生通过了考试。
